'''Assistant-Deputy-Lieutenant-in-Chief-in-charge-of-Bartending''' was a position aboard the [[Squib Reclamation Fleet]]. The [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Macemillian-winduarté]] held the position aboard the ''[[Two-For-One]]'' until he was left behind during a stopover on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Spare Parts">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref>
